title: QUIC RFC 9000 Path Validation Datagram Floor Runtime Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home execution over RFC 9000 Section 8.2 path-validation behavior, Release build compilation, canonical SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and full-suite regression testing.
scope: This verification covers the bounded runtime Section 8.2 behavior: optional co-packeted frames with path-validation frames, timer-driven PATH_CHALLENGE retries, one PATH_CHALLENGE per datagram, retry cadence discipline, small path-validation packet non-discard, immediate same-path PATH_RESPONSE emission, initiator non-enforcement of the same-path response rule, and 1200-byte path-validation datagram expansion with anti-amplification fallback.
expected_result: Focused tests prove that S8P2 path-validation frames can coexist with other frames, candidate-path retry sends additional challenges over time without bundling multiple challenges in one datagram, repeated pre-deadline traffic does not probe too frequently, too-small protected path-validation packets are processed rather than discarded, PATH_RESPONSE is emitted immediately on the same path, the initiator ignores rather than closes on a matching response received on the old path, and challenge/response datagrams are padded to 1200 bytes when path budget permits.
procedure: Run full solution tests as an outer regression gate.
preconditions: The runtime has completed enough handshake state to process protected 1-RTT PATH_CHALLENGE and PATH_RESPONSE frames.
Candidate paths can be created by attributed traffic and retain path-validation challenge payload state.
Path-local amplification state is the authority for whether a 1200-byte path-validation datagram can be sent.

supplemental_sections.heading: Focused Result
supplemental_sections.content: The focused S8P2 requirement-home filter passed 28/28 after the shared path-validation datagram builder was introduced. The adjacent S13P3 PATH_RESPONSE one-shot proof was updated to accept one response frame followed by padding, and the focused S8P2 plus S13P3 response filter passed 30/30.

status_summary: Passed for the bounded S8P2 runtime slice. The Release build passed, the focused S8P2 requirement-home run passed 28/28, the adjacent S13P3 response regression plus S8P2 filter passed 30/30, canonical SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 331 artifacts, and the full solution test suite passed 3675/3675.
